name: custap-berry
effect: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item. On the following turn, the holder will act first among moves with the same priority, regardless of Speed.
short_effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP when using a move to go first.

flavor_text.sun-moon: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it will be able to move first just once when it’s in a pinch.
